info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Consumer Service Trust Service-spec
info.description: The Consumer Service Trust Management API facilitates the creation of trust services for consumers within the banking sector. This endpoint allows authorized users to establish and manage trust relationships for consumer services, enhancing the overall security and reliability of financial transactions. Typically used by financial institutions and developers, this API supports the integration of trust services into existing consumer banking applications. Users can leverage this functionality to improve compliance with regulations and foster consumer confidence.

post.summary: Create a new trust service for consumers.
post.description: This endpoint allows for the creation of a new trust service specifically designed for consumer use, enabling better management and access to trust-related functionalities in a streamlined manner.
